587-2226-5921.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control tap for at least {2}{R}{G}{W} plus half the cost of your self-bouncing creature.
587-2226-5921.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters, its ability triggers twice through Fractured Realm.
Resolve the first Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Sawtooth Loon by paying its mana cost.
When Sawtooth Loon enters, its ability triggers twice, causing you to return itself and Zacama to your hand,  draw four cards, and put four cards on the bottom of your library.
Repeat.

5254-5686-5902.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
5254-5686-5902.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the creature with power 4 or greater.
When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Army creature token if you don't control one, then putting four +1/+1 counters on an Army you control.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability, creating a Blood token
Repeat.

147-4247-8129.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-4247-8129.notablePrerequisites: There are at least seven cards in your graveyard.
147-4247-8129.description:
Cast Stitch Together by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Stitch Together.
Holding priority, activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, giving Bloodthrone Vampire +2/+2 until end of turn.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Stitch Together
Resolve the Stitch Together copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

132-3263-3941-4687.easyPrerequisites: Myr Welder does not have summoning sickness.
132-3263-3941-4687.description:
Activate Myr Welder using Coveted Jewel's ability by tapping it, adding at least {2}{G/U}.
Activate Myr Welder using Gilder Bairn's ability by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, targeting any permanent.
Repeat.

4247-4452-5310-6879.description:
Cast Bloodghast by paying {B}{B}.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Rukarumel, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Bloodghast.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing a land creature.
When the land creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the land enters, Bloodghast triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Rukarumel, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 3.
4247-4452-5310-6879.notes: If the chosen land can enter untapped and produce mana, you may do so each iteration to get infinite mana of those color(s) and type(s).

2178-4681-6495-6542.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature with mana value 4.
2178-4681-6495-6542.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing the creature with mana value 4.
When the creature dies, Sidisi triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Resolve the Sidisi ability, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning the creature with mana value 4 from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Sidisi triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
2178-4681-6495-6542.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

2557-4094-4772-6664-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and The Wandering Minstrel.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

1594-1895-4200-6867.description:
Cast Appa either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {W}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Icewind Stalwart with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Icewind Stalwart from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Icewind Stalwart enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

215-5457-7060.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven creatures with different powers.
215-5457-7060.description:
Activate Selvala by tapping it, adding an amount of {G} or {W}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Selvala from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Selvala by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
215-5457-7060.notes: Alternate the colors of mana you add each time. If you start adding {W}, you need {G} for Temur Sabertooth and {G} to cast Selvala

112-3617-7757.manaNeeded: {1}{U} the first turn with {3}{U} each extra turn
112-3617-7757.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that can attack and that cannot be blocked or killed by an opponent.
112-3617-7757.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Declare any creature as an attacker. When you do, Doom's Time Platform triggers, exiling Time Walk from your graveyard with two time counters on it.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your upkeep, Time Walk's suspend ability triggers, removing a time counter from it.
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {3}{U}, removing a time counter from Time Walk and returning Clockspinning to your hand.
Time Walk's suspend ability triggers, causing you to cast it without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Time Walk, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat from step 2 each turn.

3417-5178-7711.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to deal damage to Red Hulk.
You control a creature that has indestructible.
3417-5178-7711.description:
Give Red Hulk and Ill-Tempered Loner // Howlpack Avenger indestructible using Odric.
Deal damage to Red Hulk.
Red Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and dealing damage to Ill-Tempered Loner // Howlpack Avenger.
Ill-Tempered Loner // Howlpack Avenger triggers, dealing damage to Red Hulk.
Repeat from step 3.
3417-5178-7711.notes: The final instance of damage can be flung at an opponent for infinite damage. If you can deal more damage to Red Hulk afterwards, you can deal infinite damage to more targets.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

413-1123-6972.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Flayer of the Hatebound
When Flayer of the Hatebound dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Flayer of the Hatebound enters, it and Blasting Station triggers.
Resolve the Flayer of the Hatebound trigger, dealing damage equal to its power to any target.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it,.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Flayer of the Hatebound
When the creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Repeat steps 3 through 5 once.
Resolve the Blasting Station abilities from step 1 and 6.
Repeat.
413-1123-6972.notes: If Flayer of the Hatebound starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 6 instead.

2438-2528-5088-7443-7537.notablePrerequisites:
You control eight or more lands.
Any one opponent cannot block and kill Emeritus of Abundance this turn.
2438-2528-5088-7443-7537.description:
Cast a copy of Regrowth from exile by paying {1}{G}, targeting any card besides the actual Regrowth.
Pyromancer's Ascension's first ability triggers, allowing you to put a quest counter on it.
Resolve the copy of Regrowth, returning that card from your graveyard to your hand.
Declare Emeritus of Abundance as an attacker.
When Emeritus of Abundance attacks, it triggers, becoming prepared.
During your second main phase, cast a copy of Regrowth by paying {1}{G}, targeting the actual Regrowth card.
Pyromancer Ascension's first ability triggers, allowing you to put a quest counter on it.
Resolve the copy of Regrowth, returning Regrowth from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Channel the Suns by paying its mana cost.
Pyromancer Ascension's second ability triggers, copying Channel the Suns.
Resolve both copies of Channel the Suns, adding mana.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Emeritus of Abundance, producing that card's result.
Cast the card Regrowth from your hand by paying {1}{G}, targeting Emeritus of Abundance.
Pyromancer Ascension's second ability triggers, copying Regrowth and allowing you to target Channel the Suns with the copy.
Resolve both copies of Regrowth, returning Emeritus of Abundance and Channel the Suns from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Channel the Suns by paying its mana cost.
Pyromancer Ascension's second ability triggers, copying Channel the Suns.
Resolve both copies of Channel the Suns, adding mana.
Cast Emeritus of Abundance by paying {2}{G}.
Cast a copy of Regrowth from exile by paying {1}{G}, targeting Channel the Suns.
Both of Pyromancer Ascension's abilities trigger.
In response, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Emeritus of Ideation, producing that card's result.
Resolve Pyromancer Ascension's first abiliity, putting a redundant quest counter on it if desired.
Resolve Pyromancer Ascension's second ability, copying Regrowth and targeting Emeritus of Abundance with the copy.
Repeat from step 15.

3963-5153-7150.easyPrerequisites: You haven't activated Kirol's ability this turn.
3963-5153-7150.notablePrerequisites: Meneldor cannot be blocked by an opponent.
3963-5153-7150.description:
Deal combat damage using Meneldor, triggering its ability.
Holding priority, activate Kirol by tapping it and Sunstrike Legionnaire. copying Meneldor's trigger, targeting Kirol.
Resolve the copy of Meneldor's trigger, blinking Kirol.
When Kirol enters, Sunstrike Legionnaire triggers, untapping Sunstrike Legionnaire.
Repeat from step 2.

856-3899-4321-6277.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
856-3899-4321-6277.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Cauldron Familiar and On Wings of Gold trigger.
Resolve the On Wings of Gold trigger, creating a token and a Food token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat

2292-3025-4681-5170.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Bastion of Remembrance triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Bastion of Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Bastion of Remembrance trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

2438-6528-7084.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Elfsworn Giant triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

147-554-2438.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-554-2438.description:
Cast Extract from Darkness by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Extract from Darkness.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Extract from Darkness
Resolve the Extract from Darkness copy, causing each player to mill two cards and returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature that does not have summoning sickness and that has power 1 or greater

262-1379-2438-4853.description:
Activate the creature with Elemental Mastery attached by tapping it, creating a number of 1/1 Elemental creature tokens with haste equal to its power.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing an Elemental.
When the Elemental dies as an artifact due to Encroaching Mycosynth, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping the creature with Elemental Mastery attached.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

745-5299-5466.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Mirrorhall Mimic
745-5299-5466.description:
Cast Mirrorhall Mimic by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Put Mirrorhall Mimic into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Mirrorhall Mimic's first ability and second ability trigger, along with Rakdos Joins Up's second ability.
Resolve Mirrorhall Mimic's second trigger and Rakdos Joins Up's trigger, dealing damage to target opponent.
Resolve Mirrorhall Mimic's first trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Repeat from step 2.

1387-1500-2633-2871-4258.description:
Cast Seething Anger with buyback by paying {R}. Urabrask, Blood Funnel and Sedgemoor Witch trigger.
Resolve the Urabrask trigger, adding {R} and dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Resolve the Sedgemoor Witch trigger, creating a 1/1 Pest creature token.
Resolve the Blood Funnel trigger, causing you to sacrifice the Pest token.
When the Pest dies, it triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Seething Anger spell.
Repeat.

565-1858-2350--118.notablePrerequisites:
You control an animated land without summoning sickness that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {U}.
You control a white permanent.
565-1858-2350--118.description:
Activate an animated land by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast View from Above by paying {U}, targeting the animated land.
Orvar triggers, creating a token copy of the animated land that is not a creature.
Resolve View from Above, returning it to your hand.
Activate the land token by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Repeat from step 2.

565-1858-6595--118.notablePrerequisites:
You control an animated land without summoning sickness that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {U}.
You control a white permanent.
565-1858-6595--118.description:
Activate an animated land by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast View from Above by paying {U}, targeting the animated land.
Orvar and Lyse's prowess ability trigger.
Resolve the Lyse trigger, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the Orvar trigger, creating a token copy of the animated land that is not a creature.
Resolve View from Above, returning it to your hand.
Activate the land token by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-2308-5870.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2034-2308-5870.description:
Gain any amount of life.
Trudge Garden triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a 4/4 Fungus Beast creature token.
When the Fungus Beast enters the battlefield, Guide of Souls triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Fungus Beast, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Guide of Souls trigger, causing you to gain life and get {E}.
Repeat from step 2.

575-4991-5971.easyPrerequisites: ZImone's ability has triggered at least once this turn.
575-4991-5971.description:
Activate Whisperwood Elemental by sacrificing it.
When Whisperwood Elemental dies, Yedora triggers, returning Whisperwood Elemental from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
When Whisperwood Elemental enters the battlefield, Zimone triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whisperwood Elemental by tapping it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Zimone trigger, turning Whisperwood Elemental face-up.
Resolve the Whisperwood Elemental ability from step 1.
Repeat.
575-4991-5971.notes: After the first loop, when Whisperwood Elemental dies, it will trigger upon death to manifest the top card of your library.

643-1429-5147-5402.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
643-1429-5147-5402.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies,  its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters the battlefield, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

413-678-862.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Crimson Kobolds.
When Crimson Kobolds dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Crimson Kobolds to your hand from your graveyard.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Crimson Kobolds by paying {0}.
When Crimson Kobolds enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

222-3074-4050.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Saproling.
222-3074-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Beetleback Chief and Slimefoot and Squee, adding two mana in any combination of {B}, {R} or {G}.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Beetleback Chief from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Beetleback Chief and Slimefoot and Squee enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger.
Resolve the Slimefoot and Squee trigger, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Resolve the Beetleback Chief trigger, creating two 1/1 Goblin creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar four times by sacrificing the two Goblins, Beetleback Chief and Slimefoot and Squee, adding {1}{B}{R}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

570-1409-2608.notablePrerequisites:
Faeburrow Elder does not have summoning sickness.
Deadeye Navigator paired with Derevi.
570-1409-2608.description:
Activate Faeburrow Elder by tapping it, adding at least {G}{W}{U}.
Activate Derevi by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
Deadeye Navigator and Derevi trigger.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing Deadeye Navigator and Derevi.
Resolve the Derevi trigger, untapping Faeburrow Elder.
Repeat.

586-618-1537-1799-3189-4738.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
586-618-1537-1799-3189-4738.description:
Cast Doomsday by paying {B}{B}{B}, searching your library and graveyard for one any other card, Zealous Conscripts, Goblin Sledder, Kiki-Jiki, and Priest of Gix, exiling all other cards from your graveyard and library, and then placing the remaining cards on top of your library in the order previously listed and losing half your life, rounded up.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Priest of Gix into your graveyard and then onto the battlefield, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Kiki-Jiki into your graveyard and then onto the battlefield.
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping, creating a token copy of Priest of Gix.
Token copy of Priest of Gix entering the battlefield, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Goblin Sledder into your graveyard and then onto the battlefield.
Activate Goblin Sledder by sacrificing it, giving Grenzo +1/+1 until end of turn.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Zealous Conscripts into your graveyard and then onto the battlefield, untapping Kiki-Jiki.
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping, creating a token copy of Zealous Conscripts.
Repeat from step 8.
